fonts.display: 'Ease Standard', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Ease Display', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Sun Yellow
palette.role: Primary action buttons, card highlights, decorative shapes, the signature pop — the only color with true filled-button authority

palette.name: Hot Pink
palette.role: Decorative borders, accent shapes, image overlays — used as visual punctuation, never as fill

palette.name: Lime Burst
palette.role: Decorative strokes, border accents, secondary highlight — energetic counterweight to Sun Yellow

palette.name: Periwinkle
palette.role: Card background, secondary action — the cool blue in an otherwise warm palette

palette.name: Spring Green
palette.role: Card backgrounds, nav highlights — warmer, more muted companion to Lime Burst

palette.name: Bubblegum
palette.role: Soft pink accent for secondary nav elements and tag pills

palette.name: Warm Linen
palette.role: Primary page canvas, soft shadow color, border tint — the warm cream that holds the whole system together

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Card surfaces, elevated content blocks — barely warmer than pure white, just enough to feel like paper

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Dark hero section background, high-contrast text container — not pure black, a warmer near-black

palette.name: Stone
palette.role: Muted card backgrounds, secondary surfaces, neutral button fills

palette.name: Sand
palette.role: Warm neutral for soft fills, secondary card backgrounds

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary text, hairline borders, icon strokes, logo — the structural color, used at extreme scale

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Muted borders, secondary dividers, disabled states
